CLOUD ROOT-CAUSE seat (dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md) for a recurring defect class of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (new work, no PR yet). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/root-cause.md and .claude/rules/defect-root-cause.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-rca-install-ratelimit, then write the PR body (headings per .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-rca-install-ratelimit <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-rca-install-ratelimit. That second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Defect class: GitHub App installation API rate limit exhausted in CI. Required checks fail with "API rate limit exceeded for installation" (gh) or aiogithubapi GitHubRatelimitException (validate-hacs). It happened 3 times on 2026-10-22: about 06:27Z, 08:40Z and 09:44Z.
- 08:40Z example: PR #2589, jobs 119726183785 (arch-score) and 119726428608 (pr-contract).
- 09:44Z example: PR #2580 head 76bcb1ee313e9d5754f18658192eb81b8b9040cd, jobs 119753501292 (arch-score) and 119753495288 (validate-hacs), plus pr-contract and env-matrix.
Each red cost a merge train a re-run cycle of an hour or more, and turned merge-ready PRs red. This is the recurrence trigger: owe a named cause, a process state, a cost test with numbers, and a countermeasure or a recorded refusal.
Establish:
1. The consumer. Which workflows and jobs call the API with the installation token, and how many calls each makes per run. Read .github/workflows/*.yml and the scripts they invoke, at origin/main. Count calls statically where you can; sample a few job logs only if needed.
2. The trigger. What multiplies the calls: recarry and merge-train pushes re-running full CI on every car, rerun-stale-contract fan-out (main showed 20 cancelled rerun-stale-contract runs at c409c9b18), pr-contract's per-PR reads, validate-hacs and arch-score. Estimate calls per hour at today's merge rate.
3. Whether the limit is the installation's 5,000/hr, or a lower or secondary limit.
Then propose the cheapest sound countermeasure, with its cost test. Candidates:
- cache or condition the API reads;
- a retry with backoff on the installation-limit class, which R10-FLY-GH-READ-RETRY (#2589) may already cover for app_approve only;
- de-duplicate rerun-stale-contract;
- use GITHUB_TOKEN where the app token is not needed.
Name the roster group that should own it: the live groups are in dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json, and new work needs a new group proposal.
Output: dev/audit/rca/install-ratelimit.md in the rca format, plus a PR body. Make no workflow change yourself; this seat records only.
SPARE THE API: it is the scarce resource here. Use at most about 150 REST calls in total. Prefer git and static reading. Never poll. Time box 75 min.
